resources.string: Pages, file size, when you added it and opened it last.
Plays this book after the one you are listening to ends.
Reads the whole book into audio files, one per chapter, in Audiobooks on your phone, to play in any app or offline. Runs in the background; a long book takes hours.
Records the book\'s voice ahead of time while your phone charges, about 6 hours at a time, so listening starts at once and uses less battery.
The book\'s clean text as an EPUB and a text file in Documents/Audora, for screen readers, braille displays and other reading apps.
An EPUB 3 in Documents/Audora with the voice in sync with the text, for e-book apps that read along. Takes about as long as reading the book aloud.
Your highlights, bookmarks and voice notes for this book as a Markdown and a text file in Documents/Audora.
Who is who in this story, only up to where you are, so nothing is spoiled.
Takes the book out of Audora. The PDF stays on your phone.
Take a photo of a printed page; Audora reads it aloud as a one-page book.
Pick folders; new PDFs in them join your library each time you open Audora.
Saves your library, places, notes and settings to one file you keep, or restores one on a new phone.
